visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long hair tied back, wearing a black short-sleeved button-up shirt and khaki cargo shorts, runs towards the camera from the courtyard of a modern apartment building. He holds a small pink card in his right hand. As he runs, the camera maintains a handheld tracking motion, getting closer until his face occupies the majority of the frame. He looks directly into the lens with an intense, slightly humorous expression. (2) The scene cuts to a digital graphic poster for the 'Taipei Toy Show'. The poster is predominantly purple and black, featuring an illustration of a muscular purple character named 'Jaygolla' and technical details like dates and location. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a physical toy figure. The figure has a muscular black body and a white 'troll face' meme head. A pair of hands enters the frame to hold and showcase the toy against a background of a patterned shirt with manga-style illustrations.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man with a man-bun hairstyle, wearing a black casual shirt and khaki cargo shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a modern residential courtyard with greenery, bushes, and a high-rise building with a dark facade. It then transitions to a static graphic background and finally a close-up featuring a character-patterned shirt.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sound of rapid, rhythmic footsteps on pavement accompanied by an upbeat, funky electronic BGM with a prominent bass line. A male voice speaks excitedly in Mandarin, with high vocal arousal, announcing the toy exhibition. (2) A sudden 'Hah!' vocal stinger and a 'Whoosh' sound effect mark the transition as the voice becomes more exaggerated. The BGM continues with a driving, high-energy beat. (3) The speaker focuses on describing the specific 'Meme Version' toy, his tone remains playful and energetic. The acoustic environment shifts from a slight outdoor reverb to a cleaner, studio-style voice-over quality as the toy is showcased.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the 2025 Taipei Toy Show. It uses an energetic, meme-inspired approach to capture attention, starting with a live-action 'hook' of the creator running, followed by event details, and concluding with a reveal of a specific limited-edition 'Meme Version' toy figure to entice collectors.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the Taipei Toy Show and the specific Infinity Toy product available for purchase.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges live-action personality with graphic design and product macro-photography to create a high-engagement promotional loop.
